scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent $npm_execpath" in pnpm/*|*pnpm*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm --filter "@workspace/card-organizer" run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter "@workspace/api-client-react" --filter "@workspace/card-organizer" --filter "@workspace/scripts" run typecheck
